result.rationale: The migration at db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb runs `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` — if no 'embed_category' setting row exists (fresh installs or sites that never configured embedding), the result set is empty and indexing [0] raises NoMethodError, crashing the migration. The diff also deletes the settings rows at the end. This mechanism is directly visible in the diff.
